description: This Java class 'InvestorAccountingHelper' provides methods for managing investor-related accounting entries, including creating journal entries, checking branch closures, and retrieving account mappings within the Fineract financial platform.

classes.name: InvestorAccountingHelper
classes.description: Service class providing helper methods for investor accounting operations such as creating journal entries, checking branch closures, and retrieving account mappings.

methods.name: checkForBranchClosures
methods.description: Checks if an accounting closure has occurred for a branch after the transaction date, throws exception if closed.

methods.name: createDebitJournalEntryOrReversalForInvestor
methods.description: Creates a debit or reversal journal entry for an investor transaction.

methods.name: createCreditJournalEntryOrReversalForInvestor
methods.description: Creates a credit or reversal journal entry for an investor transaction.

methods.name: getChargeOffMappingByCodeValue
methods.description: Retrieves charge-off account mapping based on product, type, and reason.

methods.name: createCreditJournalEntryForInvestor
methods.description: Creates a credit journal entry for an investor.

methods.name: createDebitJournalEntryForInvestor
methods.description: Creates a debit journal entry for an investor.

methods.name: getLinkedGLAccountForLoanProduct
methods.description: Retrieves linked GL account for a loan product based on account type.

methods.name: isOrganizationAccount
methods.description: Determines if an account type ID corresponds to an organization account.

methods.name: getLatestClosureByBranch
methods.description: Fetches the latest GL closure for a branch.
